facts.label: Outside services and values
facts.example: e.g. Chainlink VRF subscription 1234, or: the owner sets the feed after launch

facts.label: Which pool: the one this launch opens for its new token, with the hook attached
When the hook acts: when its pool opens, as every launch hook must, and on each swap if it takes a fee, plus whatever else you describe

Hook fee: any fee the hook takes is taken from the IMD side of each swap and sold for ETH in the same transaction, unless you ask otherwise. What its owner's price limit keeps from selling sells with the next swap's fee
Transfers: plain, with no fees, limits, pausing or minting
Split: 10% to the swarm, the other 90% is yours: 50% into the pool, the rest to your wallet
Pool: paired with IMD, opening at a 2,500 IMD market cap
Trading fee: 1.25% of every trade: 1% to you, 0.25% to IMD, claimable any time. The hook's own fee, if it takes one, is on top; "no fees" means the hook takes none
